local p = {}

-- Picks the card template for an item ID. Used by Template:Tooltip.
local Store = require('Module:DataStore')

-- NEW CARD TYPE = one line here: the category of the item (category_name in the API) -> the template that shows it.
-- Every category that is not listed uses DEFAULT.
local REGISTRY = {
	Mount = 'Mount',
	['Marine Mount'] = 'Mount',
	Glider = 'Glider',
	Pets = 'Pet',
	['Powerstone Pet'] = 'Pet',
	['Battle Pet'] = 'Pet',
	['Giant Pet'] = 'Mount',   -- Typhoon Drake
	Magithopter = 'Glider',    -- the wings of the Thunderwing Titan
	-- Potion = 'Consumable',   (listed only as an example, DEFAULT already covers it)
}
local DEFAULT = 'Consumable'
-- Categories that only get their own card when the sync script has stored the mount / glider data for the item
-- (some items of these categories, like the image items of Magithopters, have none and stay plain item cards)
local NEEDS_DATA = { ['Giant Pet'] = 'Mounts', Magithopter = 'Gliders' }

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

-- The category of an item, when the sync script has stored it (nil when not)
local function stored(id)
	local c = Store.get('Cards', id)
	if c and trim(c.category) ~= '' then return trim(c.category) end
	if Store.get('Mounts', id) then return 'Mount' end
	if Store.get('Gliders', id) then return 'Glider' end
	if Store.get('Pets', id) then return 'Pets' end
	return nil
end

-- category and card template of an item (template is nil for the plain item card)
local function cardKind(id)
	local cat = stored(id)
	local t = cat and REGISTRY[cat]
	if t and NEEDS_DATA[cat] and not Store.get(NEEDS_DATA[cat], id) then t = nil end
	return cat, t
end

-- {{#invoke:Tooltip|stored|ID}} -> "1" when the category is known from the stored data, otherwise nothing
function p.stored(frame)
	return stored(frame.args[1]) and '1' or ''
end

-- {{#invoke:Tooltip|template|id=ID|live=<category from the API>}} -> name of the card template
function p.template(frame)
	local a = frame.args
	local known, t = cardKind(a.id)
	if known then return t or DEFAULT end
	local cat = stored(a.id)
	if not cat then
		cat = trim(a.live)
		if cat:find('class="error"', 1, true) then cat = '' end
	end
	return REGISTRY[cat] or DEFAULT
end

-- {{#invoke:Tooltip|flat|<text>}}: makes a tooltip card safe to hang in the middle of a line of text
-- (Template:Item, SkillLink, BuffLink). A card is built from <div> elements, and the browser closes the
-- paragraph of the line at the first <div>: that leaves empty paragraphs (big gaps) between the items of a line.
-- So the card is rewritten here: line breaks become spaces, and every <div> becomes a <span> that looks the same:
-- a div whose classes have a display rule of their own in the card styles keeps that rule, every other div
-- gets display:block. When a card style gets a new class with a display rule (flex, grid, none ...), add the
-- class to OWN_DISPLAY, otherwise that element is shown as a plain block.
local OWN_DISPLAY = {
	['aa-buff-head'] = true, ['aa-buff-title'] = true,   -- Template:BuffLink/styles.css
	['aa-glider'] = true, ['aa-glider-head'] = true, ['aa-glider-skillrow'] = true, ['aa-glider-skills'] = true,
	['aa-glider-title'] = true, ['aa-item'] = true, ['aa-item-head'] = true, ['aa-item-title'] = true,
	['aa-mount'] = true, ['aa-mount-head'] = true, ['aa-mount-title'] = true, ['aa-mskill'] = true,
	['aa-mskill-effect'] = true, ['aa-mskill-head'] = true, ['aa-mskill-icon'] = true,
	['aa-mskill-meta'] = true, ['aa-mskill-metaline'] = true, ['aa-mskill-name'] = true,
	['aa-mskill-none'] = true, ['aa-mskill-tip'] = true, ['aa-skill'] = true, ['aa-skill-anchor'] = true,
	['aa-skill-applier'] = true, ['aa-skill-applyneed'] = true, ['aa-skill-applyrow'] = true,
	['aa-skill-applysub'] = true, ['aa-skill-boost'] = true, ['aa-skill-buff'] = true,
	['aa-skill-buffname'] = true, ['aa-skill-bufftip'] = true, ['aa-skill-chain'] = true,
	['aa-skill-chainlabel'] = true, ['aa-skill-combo'] = true, ['aa-skill-comboicons'] = true,
	['aa-skill-fact'] = true, ['aa-skill-head'] = true, ['aa-skill-req'] = true, ['aa-skill-reqnote'] = true,
	['aa-skill-set'] = true, ['aa-skill-step'] = true, ['aa-skill-stepicon'] = true, ['aa-skill-title'] = true,
	['aa-src-head'] = true, ['aa-src-all'] = true,   -- "Obtained from" part of Template:Consumable/styles.css
	['aa-varmain'] = true, ['aa-varset'] = true, ['aa-varset-v1'] = true, ['aa-varset-v2'] = true,
	['aa-varset-v3'] = true, ['aa-varset-v4'] = true, ['aa-varset-v5'] = true, ['aa-varset-v6'] = true,
}

local function divToSpan(attrs)
	attrs = attrs or ''
	local own = false
	local cls = attrs:match('class="([^"]*)"')
	if cls then
		for c in cls:gmatch('%S+') do
			if OWN_DISPLAY[c] then own = true end
		end
	end
	if not own then
		if attrs:find('style="', 1, true) then
			attrs = attrs:gsub('style="', 'style="display:block; ', 1)
		else
			attrs = attrs .. ' style="display:block"'
		end
	end
	return '<span' .. attrs .. '>'
end

local function flatten(s)
	s = tostring(s or '')
	s = s:gsub('%s*\n%s*', ' ')
	s = s:gsub('<div([^>]*)>', divToSpan)
	s = s:gsub('</div>', '</span>')
	return s
end

function p.flat(frame)
	return flatten(frame.args[1])
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- LESS EXPANSION SIZE. MediaWiki stops expanding templates on a page when the expanded text of all templates
-- together passes 2 MB ("Template include size is too large"), and every template layer around a card counts
-- the whole card again. The functions below build the hover card and the item line in Lua, so none of those
-- layers (Template:Tooltip, Template:Consumable, the many #if of Template:Item) are expanded.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local IconName = require('Module:IconName')

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

-- The card of an item, same result as {{Tooltip|id|source=...}}. Stored consumable-type items are built here
-- directly (Module:Consumable), mounts, gliders and pets still use their templates.
function p.cardHtml(frame, id, source, grade)
	local cat, kindTemplate = cardKind(id)
	if cat and not kindTemplate then
		local Consumable = require('Module:Consumable')
		local f = {
			args = { id = id, source = source or '', showgrade = grade or '' },
			expandTemplate = function(_, t) return frame:expandTemplate(t) end,
		}
		return frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = 'Template:Consumable/styles.css' } }
			.. Consumable.card(f)
	end
	return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Tooltip', args = { id, source = source or '', grade = grade or '' } }
end

-- the card, made safe to hang in the middle of a line (see flat)
function p.flatCard(frame, id, source, grade)
	return flatten(p.cardHtml(frame, id, source, grade))
end

-- The icon and the name of an item as one line. The icon and the FIRST word of the name are kept together
-- (white-space:nowrap), so a line of text can never end with the icon alone and carry the name to the next line
-- (a plain or non-breaking space is not enough: the browser may break after a picture). The rest of the name can wrap.
-- enc: how the name is made safe for the Grade template (esc for stored names, nothing for names typed by an editor).
function p.itemLine(frame, iconHtml, grade, name, enc, flex)
	enc = enc or esc
	name = tostring(name or '')
	local function g(s) return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, enc(s) } } end
	-- flex = true: the caller lays icon and name out as two flex items (RecipeBox): the icon can not leave the name
	-- there, and the name stays in ONE piece, so it must not be cut into two parts
	if flex then return iconHtml .. '<span>' .. g(name) .. '</span>' end
	local first, rest = name:match('^(%S+)%s+(.+)$')
	if first then
		return '<span style="white-space:nowrap">' .. iconHtml .. ' ' .. g(first) .. '</span> ' .. g(rest)
	end
	return '<span style="white-space:nowrap">' .. iconHtml .. ' ' .. g(name) .. '</span>'
end

-- An item by ID with its hover card (what {{Item|ItemID=...}} shows). a = { id, amount, grade, size, tip, source };
-- tip = "no" (no card) or "left" (the card opens to the left). nil when the item is not stored on the wiki yet.
function p.itemTip(frame, a)
	local d = Store.get('Items', a.id)
	if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then return nil end
	local grade = trim(a.grade)
	if grade == '' then grade = trim(d.grade) end
	-- the grade the card opens with: the one given, or else the grade the item is stored with (a recipe material is "Grand")
	local cardGrade = (grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any') and '' or grade
	if grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any' then grade = 'Basic' end
	local inner = p.itemLine(frame, IconName.icon({ args = { d.name, grade, size = tonumber(a.size) or 22, file = d.icon or '', over = d.over or '' } }),
		grade, d.name, nil, a.flex)
	local amount = trim(a.amount)
	if amount ~= '' then inner = inner .. ' × ' .. esc(amount) end
	local tip = trim(a.tip)
	if tip == 'no' or not stored(a.id) then return inner end
	return frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = 'Template:Item/styles.css' } }
		.. '<span class="aa-itemtip' .. (tip == 'left' and ' aa-itemtip-left' or '') .. '">' .. inner
		.. '<span class="aa-itemtip-card">' .. p.flatCard(frame, a.id, a.source, cardGrade) .. '</span></span>'
end

-- {{#invoke:Tooltip|item}} : the whole of Template:Item. Reads the arguments of the template that called it.
function p.item(frame)
	local a = frame:getParent().args
	local id = trim(a.ItemID or a.id)
	if id ~= '' then
		local out = p.itemTip(frame, { id = id, amount = a.amount or a[1], grade = a.grade, size = a.size, tip = a.tip, source = a.source })
		if out then return out end
		-- not stored yet: the old live code (External Data), in Template:Item/live
		local args = {}
		for k, v in pairs(a) do args[k] = v end
		return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Item/live', args = args }
	end
	-- by name: {{Item|Hay Bale|Basic|3}}
	local name = trim(a[1])
	local out = p.itemLine(frame, IconName.icon({ args = { name, a[2] or '', size = tonumber(a.size) or 22, file = a.icon or '' } }),
		a[2] or '', name, function(s) return s end)
	local amount = trim(a[3])
	if amount ~= '' then out = out .. ' × ' .. amount end
	return out
end

return p

Stored consumable-type items are built here -- directly (Module:Consumable), mounts, gliders and pets still use their templates. function p.cardHtml(frame, id, source, grade) local cat, kindTemplate = cardKind(id) if cat and not kindTemplate then local Consumable = require('Module:Consumable') local f = { args = { id = id, source = source or '', showgrade = grade or '' }, expandTemplate = function(_, t) return frame:expandTemplate(t) end, } return frame:extensionTag{ name = 'templatestyles', args = { src = 'Template:Consumable/styles.css' } } .. Consumable.card(f) end return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Tooltip', args = { id, source = source or '', grade = grade or '' } } end -- the card, made safe to hang in the middle of a line (see flat) function p.flatCard(frame, id, source, grade) return flatten(p.cardHtml(frame, id, source, grade)) end -- The icon and the name of an item as one line. The rest of the name can wrap. -- enc: how the name is made safe for the Grade template (esc for stored names, nothing for names typed by an editor). function p.itemLine(frame, iconHtml, grade, name, enc, flex) enc = enc or esc name = tostring(name or '') local function g(s) return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Grade', args = { grade, enc(s) } } end -- flex = true: the caller lays icon and name out as two flex items (RecipeBox): the icon can not leave the name -- there, and the name stays in ONE piece, so it must not be cut into two parts if flex then return iconHtml .. '' .. g(name) .. '' end local first, rest = name:match('^(%S+)%s+(.+)$') if first then return '' .. iconHtml .. ' ' .. g(first) .. ' ' .. g(rest) end return '' .. iconHtml .. ' ' .. g(name) .. '' end -- An item by ID with its hover card (what {{Item|ItemID=...}} shows). a = { id, amount, grade, size, tip, source }; -- tip = "no" (no card) or "left" (the card opens to the left). nil when the item is not stored on the wiki yet. function p.itemTip(frame, a) local d = Store.get('Items', a.id) if not d or trim(d.name) == '' then return nil end local grade = trim(a.grade) if grade == '' then grade = trim(d.grade) end -- the grade the card opens with: the one given, or else the grade the item is stored with (a recipe material is "Grand") local cardGrade = (grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any') and '' or grade if grade == '' or grade == 'None' or grade == 'Any' then grade = 'Basic' end local inner = p.itemLine(frame, IconName.icon({ args = { d.name, grade, size = tonumber(a.size) or 22, file = d.icon or '', over = d.over or '' } }), grade, d.name, nil, a.flex) local amount = trim(a.amount) if amount ~= '' then inner = inner .. '' .. inner .. '' .. p.flatCard(frame, a.id, a.source, cardGrade) .. '' end -- {{#invoke:Tooltip|item}} : the whole of Template:Item. Reads the arguments of the template that called it. function p.item(frame) local a = frame:getParent().args local id = trim(a.ItemID or a.id) if id ~= '' then local out = p.itemTip(frame, { id = id, amount = a.amount or a[1], grade = a.grade, size = a.size, tip = a.tip, source = a.source }) if out then return out end -- not stored yet: the old live code (External Data), in Template:Item/live local args = {} for k, v in pairs(a) do args[k] = v end return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'Item/live', args = args } end -- by name: {{Item|Hay Bale|Basic|3}} local name = trim(a[1]) local out = p.itemLine(frame, IconName.icon({ args = { name, a[2] or '', size = tonumber(a.size) or 22, file = a.icon or '' } }), a[2] or '', name, function(s) return s end) local amount = trim(a[3]) if amount ~= '' then out = out .. ' × ' .. amount end return out end return p
